method: Read every file in the assigned source and related test inventory, followed the relevant runtime/deployment contracts, and ran six safe in-memory source probes against local substitutes. No old repository, old tests or old Git history was inspected.

findings.title: Unknown browser intents have no explicit reviewed-abandonment recovery path
trigger: Submit conversation/start or turn/start, then lose the response after the transport boundary.
The gateway durably records unknown. The administrator inspects history and uses the stop-confirmed restart/repair path, which correctly clears only activityUncertain.

Return to the same project new-conversation draft or same thread: the original unknown record remains and blocks any new intent. Recovery only offers another read, never an explicit reviewed abandonment.
findings.impact: A single persistent unknown can permanently disable new conversations for the project or later turns for the thread in this browser profile; clearing localStorage manually is the only existing escape, losing safe tombstones.

result.acknowledge: 未知操作仍需保留，不能据此重复发送。
result.newIntent: 此操作还有待确认的请求。请先查询回执。

findings.requiredBehavior: Provide an explicit, fenced recovery action that preserves original unknown facts/tombstones and never automatically replays. A not_received observation alone must not authorize it.
findings.statusAtReport: communicated; gateway operation/retire work appeared during review; browser fix still being implemented

findings.title: Optional form fields collapse omission, false, first enum value, and empty arrays
trigger: Select the second optional enum choice, then choose the blank placeholder.
Select true in an optional boolean, then choose the blank placeholder.
Clear an optional number, or try to submit an explicitly empty required array without toggling one of its entries first.
findings.impact: The enum becomes its first choice (Number("") is 0); boolean becomes false; cleared optional number remains an own undefined property and fails validation; required empty arrays cannot be explicitly initialized and optional arrays cannot return to omission. These change or block valid MCP answers.

evidence.type: current TSX transformed in memory with Vite/Oxc and exercised in jsdom

findings.title: Terminal notifications preceding open response are silently lost
trigger: Keep terminal/open HTTP response pending.
Deliver terminal output and then exit for its terminalId over the event socket.
Resolve terminal/open with the same id.
findings.impact: The listener rejects every early event while terminalId.current is empty; initial shell output is lost, and a quickly exited shell is then shown as an active terminal with a Close button. No terminal history/read API can restore those events.

evidence.type: current TerminalPanel compiled in memory with stub xterm and jsdom

findings.title: Three small pending RPCs exhaust gateway admission and block recovery reads
trigger: Hold three tiny authenticated model/list HTTP calls pending in the worker.
Issue an authenticated operation/read for an unrelated operation.
findings.impact: Each tiny call is charged as the full 8 MiB request ceiling against a 24 MiB total, so the fourth call fails capacity. App startup/reconnection fans out more than three reads and aborts older generations without stopping backend retention, making this a normal recovery-path failure rather than only a large-upload limit.

evidence.type: real loopback GatewayServer + in-memory Ledger + held local worker substitute

findings.statusAtReport: root changed to incremental chunk charging while audit was active; inspected the new code but did not rerun this probe after the fix

findings.title: File approval accepts changes even when their review content has not loaded
trigger: Reconnect or navigate to a thread with a pending file approval.
prompt/list completes before history, or history fails/exceeds its limit, so the matching fileChange item is absent.
Click the enabled accept button.
findings.impact: The approval request itself contains identities/reason/grantRoot, not the diff; the only diff source is optional contextItems.find(itemId). The current UI sends accept while showing no changed paths/content, violating review-before-approval. Matching only itemId also omits explicit turn identity.

evidence.type: current Prompts compiled in memory and exercised in jsdom

findings.requiredBehavior: Only offer acceptance when current thread/turn/item changes are fully available, with safe retry/detail access; separately present legitimate grantRoot authorization semantics.

findings.title: Service log UI always sends a parameter rejected by the installed manager
trigger: Open Settings -> service administration in a real installed instance.
The UI sends system/logs with {limit:100}; dispatcher forwards params unchanged.
findings.impact: Manager accepts only service and lines, so every initial read and retry fails Invalid logs parameters. The visual fixture does not validate the params and therefore masked this integration defect.

findings.title: Composer shows old thread defaults after persistent native turn overrides
trigger: Resume a thread and retain its initial threadDefaults.
Send a turn with an explicit model/effort/approvalPolicy/sandbox override.
After successful acknowledgement the draft/options clear, but threadDefaults are not refreshed. Select or observe the UI default again and send with omitted options.
findings.impact: Official TurnStartParams documents those overrides as applying to subsequent turns. The UI displays the pre-override values while the runtime continues using the previous override. An earlier never or danger-full-access choice can therefore persist behind misleading default labels.

evidence.type: source flow plus generated official protocol contract
evidence.nativeSemantics: model, reasoning effort, approval policy and sandbox overrides apply to this turn and subsequent turns

findings.requiredBehavior: Align displayed and dispatched defaults field by field, and reconcile the README promise that default means effective project/provider configuration rather than an old override.
findings.statusAtReport: web owner confirmed official sticky behavior and is implementing refreshed resume/default labels; no paid turn run

findings.title: The second acceptance cleanup deletes an edited draft despite its changed revision
trigger: Start sending a draft. While the request is pending, change its model/permission options without changing text or attachment IDs.
The accepted receipt correctly preserves the changed revision through clearDraftSnapshot.
App then calls draftState.accepted, whose acceptDraft compares only text/IDs and deletes the changed draft.
findings.impact: A later user edit is lost and selected options revert to defaults; this contradicts the documented unchanged-revision cleanup invariant. Composer leaves these controls editable during dispatch.

evidence.type: current drafts.ts source loaded in memory with jsdom storage

findings.title: Full-audit gate accepts sampled source coverage as complete
trigger: Create three clean, correctly hashed evidence artifacts against the current digest.
List one existing source file per required area, but omit another source file in those same areas and all related tests/docs.
Set complete:true: validateAuditRecord only tests that each regex has at least one inspected file.
findings.impact: The executable full-suite gate cannot enforce the stated full-repository review prerequisite; a partial reviewer manifest can authorize full testing while uninspected files are part of the bound digest. This is a workflow-integrity defect, not evidence that this review ran full tests.

evidence.type: static path-condition inspection; no audit records forged and no full tests invoked

findings.requiredBehavior: Check the union of inspectedFiles against the declared required source/test/document inventory for every round, with explicit legitimate exclusions.

limitations: This was an integration preaudit, not any of the three formal full-repository clean rounds. Findings are not a clean bill of health.

The repository was being actively changed by other agents. Locations and probes refer to the source read during this review; gateway budget/admission changes appeared before this report, and web fixes were in progress. No immutable final-snapshot conclusion is claimed.
All assigned source files and corresponding gateway/core/web/tooling tests were read. Runtime/deployment modules were inspected only at the named cross-module contracts, not comprehensively.
No full test suite, paid inference, real account login, external MCP call, deployment, migration, remote host mutation, or legacy repository/source/test/history access occurred.

Six focused offline probes used the current source with in-memory transformation/storage or a loopback local substitute. They reproduce defects, not repaired regressions; jsdom and stub xterm are not real browser/OS IME/Linux PTY acceptance.

Existing tests were reviewed but not rerun as a broad batch. Real browser visual layout, mobile device accessibility, native account/MCP authorization and production provider behavior remain unverified.

The initial suspicion that activityUncertain had no recovery path was withdrawn after reading deploy/manager.py and deploy/journal.py: stop-confirmed restart/repair does clear the server barrier while correctly retaining unknown receipts. CW-01 concerns the remaining browser intent lifecycle.
